rule:
Hold-out 7 selection (fixed before any run): every eligible record (open licence, .mpr reachable directly or
inside a zip that supports HTTP Range, <= 30 MB, magic not known to be wrong), up to K files per record, chosen by
sha256("holdout7|<record>|<url>|<member>") order. Same-stem .mpt/.txt exports of chosen files come along.
Writes holdout7_sources.json. After download, records with a file byte-identical to one used before are dropped entirely, and byte-identical copies within the set are dropped (see excluded_after_download).
